kind: pre-registered analysis of existing reproduction outputs; no training, no new model forward
freeze_statement: 冻结时，编写者未读取 mquake-paper-reproduction-v1 或 rippleedits-paper-reproduction-v1 的任何逐例记录或汇总；两批进度文件只含按总跳数的汇总，不含按被编辑事实跳位的分组。分组计数只来自公开数据，数据SHA256与两批冻结配置一致。
hypothesis: 路径一致性工作假说：更新只传到使用被写入计算路径的查询。ROME/MEMIT在显式主体词元上写入；被编辑事实作首跳时组合问题含该主体，作后续跳时主体只作为隐含桥实体出现。

bootstrap.unit: case; MQuAKE resampled jointly within hop-count strata, RippleEdits over all analysed cases

mquake.groups: single-edit cases; first = edited fact at hop 1, later = edited fact at hop >= 2; hop position by the reproduction's own subject/relation/new-target matching in new_triples
mquake.scores: reproduction's frozen scores: direct = any of 3 questions exact alias match; cot = any CoT answer exact alias match; prerequisites = baseline direct correct, all new single hops correct after edit, all edits successful

primary.M2: full pool, interaction: (first - later | direct) - (first - later | cot)

secondary.S1: M1 and M2 in the prerequisite subset, with coverage
secondary.S2: old answer retained after edit (cases whose old and new alias sets are disjoint), per cell
secondary.S3: 4-hop single-edit cells and multi-edit cases (includes hop 1 or not): descriptive only

rippleedits.groups: CI tests (edited subject explicit, edited fact at hop 1) versus CII tests (edited subject is the implicit first-hop target, edited fact at hop 2); tests failing this structure are excluded and counted
rippleedits.scores: author evaluator outcomes saved by the reproduction: PASSED/FAILED among executed tests of successfully edited cases

primary.R1: per subset, test-level accuracy CI - CII, case-resampled interval

secondary.R2: cases containing both axes: mean within-case CI - CII, descriptive

predictions.P1: M1 > 0 for both ROME and MEMIT
predictions.P2: M2 > 0: explicit CoT bridge tokens shrink the hop-position gap
predictions.P4: S2: old answer retained more often when the edit is at a later hop

interpretation.supports: P1 and P2 hold for both editors, with P3 in the same direction
interpretation.against: M1 interval at or below 0 for both editors, or P1 holds while M2 is about 0 (then case or entity-type differences explain the gap better than path mismatch)
interpretation.limits: groups are different cases, so entity types and relations differ; M2 is the within-case control; RippleEdits has no CoT control; one model per benchmark; this tests the natural-model consequence of the hypothesis, not its controlled-model mechanism

not_permitted: running analyze on incomplete or unaudited runs
changing groups, strata, scores or bootstrap settings after reading outcomes
replacing the full-pool primary with the prerequisite subset
